description: Little Ward (작은 결계): a small square ward of pale-gold light standing in the air like a glowing window frame, a few motes of light drifting inside it.
Shadow Dance (그림자 군무): two dark silhouettes of figures swapping places along a curved trail of shadow, a faint burnt-orange glint between them.
Teacher's Quill (스승의 깃펜): a long grey-white quill pen with a plain silver nib, a drop of glowing pale-gold ink at its tip (Lia's teacher's quill).
The Grey Ledger (회색 장부): a slim closed ledger bound in grey leather with a plain iron clasp, a faint cold silver sheen on its cover, no writing.
